name: healthflex.app
description: React Native healthcare app with BLE sensor integration, exercise engine, real-time rep counting, and ML-powered feedback for physiotherapy
summary: Cross-platform React Native healthcare app built at HealthFlex with 57 merged PRs. Led BLE 2.0 migration (+1164/-383 lines), Component Migration (+14193/-4127 lines), Algorithm Utils (+878 lines), and Non-measurable Flow refactor (+5400/-3055 lines). Features exercise engine with rep counting, hold detection, 20Hz sensor streaming, and Expo SDK 52 with FlashList optimization.
features: Exercise engine with rep counting, hold detection, and timeout handling
BLE 2.0 sensor integration streaming at 20Hz per device
Audio feedback system with context pattern for exercise cues
Expo SDK 52 migration with FlashList optimization
ROM calculation optimization for lower-end devices
BLE error handling with comprehensive permission states
Memory management and stream subscription cleanup
OTA updates via Expo EAS with multi-environment releases

major_contributions.description: Major app refactor with full component migration architecture
Complex flow refactor for non-measurable exercise types
Complete BLE stack rewrite with improved connectivity and error handling
Implemented modular exercise strategy pattern for different exercise types
Migrated exercise state management to event emitter architecture
Fixed exercise hold detection getting stuck on certain states
Enabled large heap for Android to handle sensor data streaming
Exercise algorithm utilities for rep counting and ROM calculation

resume_highlights: Led BLE 2.0 migration (+1164 lines) with complete sensor stack rewrite improving connectivity and 20Hz streaming reliability
Architected Component Migration (+14193 lines) refactoring entire app structure for maintainability
Implemented Non-measurable Flow (+5400/-3055 lines) enabling complex exercise types without sensor requirements
Built Algorithm Utils (+878 lines) for real-time rep counting, ROM calculation, and exercise feedback
Developed Event Emitter architecture for decoupled exercise state management across app components
Authored 57 merged PRs totaling 45K+ lines of code over 6-month contribution period
